Subject: Pop Quiz question 
 
This week’s Pop Quiz question comes to us from Gary Mintz of South Huntington, N.Y.:

What general manager was once known as “George Costanza” within the New York Yankees organization (in reference to the popular character from the 1990s sitcom, “Seinfeld”) before his father’s personal friend and business associate, principal owner George M. Steinbrenner, named him the second-youngest G.M. in Major League Baseball history in 1998, received complete autonomy or control of all of New York’s baseball operations departments in 2005, and was responsible for the Yankees winning only one (1) American League pennant and only one (1) world championship from 2006-2015 while spending more money on player contracts, or payroll,  than any MLB or A.L. franchise by a substantial margin in each of those ten (10) years?
If you have a tidbit that connects baseball with popular culture, please send it to Steven Marcus at licollege.com.
